identified_gaps.possible_remediation: Install required packages into the runtime (e.g., python -m pip install h5py anndata) or provide a prebuilt environment containing these packages.

identified_gaps.title: Repository environment provisioning is brittle/missing
execution_evidence: execution_tool_outputs: venv contained only pip; agent needed to install h5py/anndata at runtime
testing_report.recommendations: instructs to pip install h5py anndata and rerun
identified_gaps.explanation: The repository does not ensure a ready-to-use scientific Python environment for running notebook-derived workflows; users must manually provision dependencies during execution.
identified_gaps.likely_impact: Increases friction and failure rate for reproducing analyses, especially in ephemeral or locked-down environments; novice users may not be able to reproduce without guidance.
identified_gaps.possible_remediation: Provide explicit, runnable environment provisioning (requirements.txt/conda yml/docker image) and document exact install steps; include automated CI or setup scripts that install the scientific stack.

execution_gaps: Missing HDF5/AnnData Python packages prevented reading .h5ad
recommended_followups: Install h5py and anndata in the target runtime and re-run the count (the session produced output '5000' after installing these).
Add explicit environment provisioning (requirements.txt / conda env / Dockerfile / CI step) and a short README note so runs do not depend on manual package installation.
gap_report.notes: Although the testing_report marked the workflow as blocked due to missing h5py, the execution_answer shows the agent installed dependencies and successfully read the file, printing 5000 observations. The root reproducibility gaps are the missing dependencies and the repo's lack of pre-provisioned environment.

gate_decision.reasoning: The worker manually resolved the missing h5py/anndata packages and successfully loaded the .h5ad file, so the execution-time gap was validly bypassed.
